errors.evidence: The description states the x-axis range is from 8,000 to 42,000, but the labeled axis ticks clearly show a range from 10,000 to 40,000. The stated values are an incorrect estimation of the data point range, not the axis range.

The description omits the tick label interval for both the x-axis (which is 5,000) and the y-axis (which is 0.2), despite the prompt specifically requesting this information for numeric and regularly spaced axes.
The description fails to mention that the plot has two identical y-axes, one on the left and one on the right. This is a structural feature of the plot.
